policy.ownerRequirement: Create repositories only while authenticated as the target owner or an organization admin. Do not let GitHub CLI fall back to the current personal account.
policy.noRawAddress: Do not store raw personal addresses, recipient records, private coordinates, witness data, or private keys in public repositories.
policy.heavyData: Keep building polygons, coordinates, search indexes, tiles, OSM/Overture extracts, and generated caches in external content-addressed packs.
policy.childDataReadiness: A child repository marked for GitHub creation is not data-ready by default; it must still add manifest, sources, quality gates, tests, and no-raw checks before publication.
policy.stagedCreation: This country plan marks only the parent repository for creation; children remain logical until maintainers and datasets are ready.

repositories.creationRationale: Parent repositories can be bootstrapped with manifest, rules, sources, quality gates, and synthetic fixtures before any real address dataset is published.
repositories.description: AGID country or territory pack for Guatemala (GT); stores safe rules, sources, quality gates, and synthetic fixtures only.
